hero.h1: US Tax Accountant in Vancouver, BC
hero.text: LeadTax helps US citizens, green card holders and people with ties to both countries file US and Canadian returns together in Vancouver and Burnaby, BC. We review foreign tax credits, foreign account reporting such as FBAR, and missed prior-year filings. Learn how [personal tax filing](/personal-tax) fits in, read our guide on [US taxes for Americans in Vancouver](/blog/us-taxes-americans-living-in-vancouver) or [book a consultation](/contact).

deadlines.title: What Are the Key Cross-Border Deadlines and Thresholds?

items.title: US return
items.text: Due April 15. US citizens and residents living abroad get an automatic extension to June 15, but interest generally applies to tax paid after April 15.

items.title: FBAR
items.text: Required when foreign accounts total more than $10,000 at any time in the year. It is due April 15, with an automatic extension to October 15.

items.title: Form 8938
items.text: Thresholds are higher for taxpayers living abroad. For example, a single filer abroad generally reports above $200,000 at year-end or $300,000 at any time.

items.title: Form T1135 (Canada)
items.text: Currently required when foreign property costs more than $100,000 at any time in the year. Budget 2026 proposes raising that to $200,000, but it is not yet law.

deadlines.note: Filing one form does not replace another. Read [FBAR vs Form 8938 vs T1135](/blog/fbar-form-8938-t1135-canadian-residents) for a full comparison.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Cross-Border Tax in Vancouver

items.question: I am a US citizen living in Canada. Do I still need to file a US return?
items.answer: Generally yes. The US taxes citizens and green card holders on worldwide income wherever they live. Many owe no US tax after foreign tax credits, but the return is still required.

items.question: Will I pay tax twice on the same income?
items.answer: Often not. Foreign tax credits and the Canada-US tax treaty can reduce or remove double taxation, and we review both returns together to apply them correctly.

items.question: What if I have not filed US returns for several years?
items.answer: Contact us before you file anything. We identify which years and forms are outstanding and discuss the options available to you.

items.question: Can I work with LeadTax remotely?
items.answer: Yes. Share documents securely, review your prepared returns online and approve before filing. Prefer a visit? [Contact us](/contact).

items.question: How much does cross-border tax preparation cost?
items.answer: Fees depend on the forms, accounts and years involved. We confirm the scope and fee before work begins.
